title: A Day in the Park
setting: A green park on a cool spring day.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Leo and Mia go to the park.
sentences.zh: 星期二，里奥和米娅去公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) walk through the gate of a green park on a cool spring day.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Leo and Mia walking into the park; the day Tuesday can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Leo and Mia walk through the gate of a green park on a cool spring day.

sentence_targets.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

sentences.en: He is really tall and strong; Mia is small.
sentences.zh: 他又高又壮，米娅却很小。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) stands next to Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) on the park path; he is twice her height.
sentences.narration: Leo stands next to Mia on the park path. he is twice her height.

sentence_targets.en: having great physical power or force
Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.

sentences.en: Mia wears a red coat and a hat.
sentences.zh: 米娅穿着红外套，戴着帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close view of Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), now wearing a red coat over her hoodie and a red woolly hat, smiling.
sentences.narration: Close view of Mia, now wearing a red coat over her hoodie and a red woolly hat, smiling.

sentence_targets.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

sentences.en: Their school has a fun activity there today.
sentences.zh: 他们学校今天在那里有一个有趣的活动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Children in sports clothes line up for a race on the park grass, a teacher with a whistle in front, Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) among them.
sentences.narration: Children in sports clothes line up for a race on the park grass, a teacher with a whistle in front, Leo and Mia among them.

sentence_targets.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.

sentences.en: Leo is fast, and Mia also runs quickly.
sentences.zh: 里奥跑得快，米娅也跑得很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) race across the grass with other children, both running fast.
sentences.narration: Leo and Mia race across the grass with other children, both running fast.

sentence_targets.en: in addition to something already mentioned
moving or happening at high speed
At a fast speed or after only a short time.

sentences.en: Mia falls, and mud gets on her clothes.
sentences.zh: 米娅摔倒了，衣服上沾满了泥。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), in her red coat, sits on the muddy grass after a fall, her coat and jeans dirty, about to cry.
sentences.narration: Mia, in her red coat, sits on the muddy grass after a fall, her coat and jeans dirty, about to cry.

sentence_targets.en: items worn to cover the body

sentences.en: Leo gives her a sandwich from his lunch.
sentences.zh: 里奥把午饭里的一块三明治给了她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) kneels and offers Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) a sandwich from his open lunch box.
sentences.narration: Leo kneels and offers Mia a sandwich from his open lunch box.

sentence_targets.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
showing where someone or something starts or originates

sentences.en: Soon nothing hurts, and she runs without crying.
sentences.zh: 很快就不疼了，她又跑了起来，不再哭了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) runs again on the grass, smiling, her face dry, while Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) cheers beside her.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia running again, happy and not crying; 'nothing hurts' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Mia runs again on the grass, smiling, her face dry, while Leo cheers beside her.

sentence_targets.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not anything; no thing at all
Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
